title: Profile
text:
Name: Tadao Hoshino (星野匡郎)

Hoshino (星野) is my family name and it means “field of stars”

Languages: Japanese (native), English (fluent)
Hobbies: Piano, Origami (paper folding), Shogi (Japanese chess)

title: Profile
text:
Employment

Current position

Since April 2024: Professor, School of Political Science and Economics, Waseda University.



Past positions

April 2018 – March 2024: Associate Professor, School of Political Science and Economics, Waseda University.
April 2016 – March 2018: Assistant Professor (tenured), Department of Business Economics, Tokyo University of Science.
April 2014 – March 2016: Assistant Professor (non-tenured), Global Education Center, Waseda University.
April 2012 – March 2014: Research Fellow PD, Japan Society for the Promotion of Science.
April 2010 – March 2012: Research Fellow DC2, Japan Society for the Promotion of Science.

title: Profile

MSc in Local Economic Development: London School of Economics, November 2008.
BA in Economics: Waseda University, March 2007.
